_how: Settings for tools/pack_wide.py (the web point cloud, thinned with distance from Y-1). Edit a value, then run:  python site-model/houdini/tools/pack_wide.py pack   (a few minutes; no Houdini needed). Command-line flags such as --r0 250 override this file for a one-off trial.
_full_density_radius_m: Everything within this radius of Y-1 keeps every return; the fade starts here.
_falloff_power: How fast objects thin out beyond the radius: keep share ~ (radius / distance) ^ power. Larger = sparser sooner.
_density: Overall amount: every keep share beyond the radius is multiplied by this (0.7 = 30 % fewer points, same fade shape).
_density_inside_too: true = the overall amount also thins the full-density centre.
_keep_min: Objects whose share falls below this are left out entirely; sets how ragged the edge is.
_edge_end_m: Outer taper: everything fades to nothing between edge_end_m - edge_width_m and edge_end_m (+-12 % noise), so the cloud ends before the square edge of the 9-tile data (~1.42 km east).
_object_jitter: Each object's own random stretch of its distance (+-): larger = neighbouring objects differ more, more ragged fade.
_noise_amplitude: Large-scale wobble of the fade (+-), so it is not a circle.
_ground_patch_m: Ground / _other / street furniture are not objects: their fade is broken into irregular patches of about this size.
_mist: Optional faint haze beyond the fade (share of every object, e.g. 0.005), ending at mist_end_m. 0 = off.
